structure.desktop: 3-Column Tactical Grid (Left: Agent Identity & Profile | Center: Always-Visible Activity Stream & Terminal Outputs | Right: Token Market & Live Chart)
structure.mobile: Single Column Vertical Stack with Agent Identity Sticky Bar, Stream Feed, and Collapsible Chart Panel

layout_architecture.hairline_grid: 1px solid #27272A (zinc-800) dark borders between panels with subtle inner shadow to mimic hardware terminal monitors

agent_terminal_specifications.compute_credit_placement: HIDDEN_IN_SETTINGS (Accessed via gear icon data-testid='agent-settings-trigger' in top agent bar. Never main hero/header splash).
agent_terminal_specifications.activity_feed_visibility: ALWAYS_OPEN_TERMINAL (Outputs, timestamped thoughts, model responses, and event radar are expanded inline without requiring tab toggling or click modals).
agent_terminal_specifications.language_requirement: 100% English interface text and translated historical display labels.

typography.headline_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational components MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all new UI components are written in React JS (.js / .jsx) format.
Maintain 100% English UI copy throughout all agent views, activity terminals, and settings dialogs.
Do not display compute credits or token consume costs prominently in main hero headings. Place compute limits, credit estimation, and scheduler controls inside the settings drawer/modal.
Ensure the terminal activity log and research model streams are expanded and directly visible on load without requiring user clicks.
Maintain high-contrast APCA readable text over dark terminal surfaces.
Include explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, tabs, buttons, and settings triggers.
